name: Discovery daily (per-project sources become ai-build tickets)

knobs.note: BH-9795: comma list of the discovery sources this project reads (part 1: sentry). Each name needs bin/lib/discovery/<name>.sh. Empty = the lane does nothing for the project and the missed-run check skips it. Read in bin/lib/discovery-daily.sh as ${DISCOVERY_SOURCES:-}. Set it per project with bin/discovery-setup.sh. Checked before use: with the spaces removed the whole value must match ^[a-z0-9,-]*$ (else one log line and no source is read), and each name must match ^[a-z0-9-]+$ and have bin/lib/discovery/<name>.sh (else one log line and that name is skipped).
BH-9795: the Sentry organization slug of the sentry source. Read in bin/lib/discovery/sentry.sh as ${DISCOVERY_SENTRY_ORG:-operator}; a value outside ^[a-z0-9_-]+$ is not-configured.

BH-9795: the Sentry project slug of the sentry source. Empty = the source is not-configured (one log line, no fetch, no call). Read in bin/lib/discovery/sentry.sh as ${DISCOVERY_SENTRY_PROJ:-}; a value outside ^[a-z0-9_-]+$ is not-configured. Set it per project with bin/discovery-setup.sh.

BH-9795: owner/repo the lane files tickets in and reads open issues from. Empty = the project's fleet.conf repo (the registry repo). A value that is not owner/repo, or that fleet.conf does not name in column 2, is not used: the run logs one line (value not logged) and reads nothing. Read in bin/lib/discovery-daily.sh as ${DISCOVERY_TARGET_REPO:-}. Set it per project with bin/discovery-setup.sh --repo.

BH-9795: the event count an item needs before the lane acts on it. Below it: no ledger row and no model call. Read in bin/lib/discovery-daily.sh as ${DISCOVERY_MIN_EVENTS:-3}; outside 1..100000 is one log line and the default.
BH-9795: the sentry source reads unresolved issues seen in the last this many hours. Read in bin/lib/discovery-daily.sh as ${DISCOVERY_LOOKBACK_H:-24}.

BH-9795: new tickets the lane may file per project per UTC day (ledger row discovery-daily-day/<project>/<date>). At the cap the run stops; the rest count as capped and are offered again the next day. 0 files no ticket. Read in bin/lib/discovery-daily.sh as ${DISCOVERY_TICKETS_DAY:-5}.

BH-9795: model calls the lane may start per project per UTC day, counted in the day row BEFORE each call. With DISCOVERY_MAX_USD this bounds the day's spend at calls x MAX_USD (default 10 x 0.50). 0 makes no call. Read in bin/lib/discovery-daily.sh as ${DISCOVERY_MAX_CALLS_DAY:-10}.
BH-9795: USD cap on each model call, passed as AGENT_CALL_BUDGET_USD_DISCOVERY_DAILY. 0 makes no call and writes no row. Read in bin/lib/discovery-daily.sh as ${DISCOVERY_MAX_USD:-0.50}.
BH-9795: call attempts an item gets before it is written failed and raises one warn alert discovery-daily-failed. Read in bin/lib/discovery-daily.sh as ${DISCOVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS:-3}.
BH-9795: a new ticket gets the hotfix label when the item's events in the last 24 h are at or above this number. Read in bin/lib/discovery-daily.sh as ${DISCOVERY_HOTFIX_24H:-50}.
BH-9795: days the raw fetch snapshots under state/discovery-daily/<project>/<date>/ are kept; each run deletes older date dirs. Read in bin/lib/discovery-daily.sh as ${DISCOVERY_RAW_KEEP_D:-14}.

BH-9795: days the missed-run check keeps its missed-ok-* and missed-alerted-* markers under state/discovery-daily/; each pipeline-health tick deletes older ones. Read in bin/lib/discovery-missed.sh as lane_knob discovery-daily DISCOVERY_MARKER_KEEP_D; empty or outside 1..365 is the fallback 30. The check reads it with no project, so only the lane-wide row applies.

BH-9795: the whole run is killed after this many seconds (timeout re-exec). The run row is claimed with a stale time of this plus 60 s. Read in bin/discovery-daily.sh and bin/lib/discovery-daily.sh as ${DISCOVERY_RUN_TIMEOUT_S:-1500}.

BH-9795: seconds one model call may run (agent-call.sh timeout argument). Read in bin/lib/discovery-daily.sh as ${DISCOVERY_CALL_TIMEOUT_S:-300}. LANE-WIDE: lane.discovery-daily.<project>.discovery_call_timeout_s is 65 characters for the longest fleet slug and PUT /api/settings refuses anything over 64, so this one has no per-project row.

BH-9795: bytes of the item detail (the source adapter's detail file) dd_prompt puts in the prompt; the rest is cut. Read in bin/lib/discovery-daily.sh as ${DISCOVERY_DETAIL_MAX_BYTES:-12000}; outside 1000..100000 is one log line and the default. LANE-WIDE: lane.discovery-daily.<project>.discovery_detail_max_bytes is 67 characters for the longest fleet slug and PUT /api/settings refuses anything over 64, so this one has no per-project row.

BH-9795: chars of the item title dd_prompt passes to st_candidates to find candidate open tickets. Read in bin/lib/discovery-daily.sh as ${DISCOVERY_CAND_MATCH_CHARS:-60}; outside 10..300 is one log line and the default. LANE-WIDE: lane.discovery-daily.<project>.discovery_cand_match_chars is 67 characters for the longest fleet slug and PUT /api/settings refuses anything over 64, so this one has no per-project row.

BH-9795: the title of a ticket dd_act files is cut to this many chars (GitHub allows 256). Read in bin/lib/discovery-daily.sh as ${DISCOVERY_TICKET_TITLE_CHARS:-120}; outside 40..256 is one log line and the default. LANE-WIDE: lane.discovery-daily.<project>.discovery_ticket_title_chars is 69 characters for the longest fleet slug and PUT /api/settings refuses anything over 64, so this one has no per-project row.

BH-9795: chars of the fetched item title dd_item keeps in the item ledger row. Read in bin/lib/discovery-daily.sh as ${DISCOVERY_ITEM_TITLE_CHARS:-300}; outside 40..2000 is one log line and the default. LANE-WIDE: lane.discovery-daily.<project>.discovery_item_title_chars is 67 characters for the longest fleet slug and PUT /api/settings refuses anything over 64, so this one has no per-project row.

0 makes this lane call no model at all. bin/lib/llm-gate.sh refuses BEFORE the vendor call and writes a zero-cost row_source=refused row, so the stop is visible in the ledger rather than being a lane that went quiet.
Comma/space list of the ONLY ladder rungs this lane may reach. Empty is every rung, i.e. today's ladder unchanged. A rung outside the list is refused before the call.
Dollars this lane may spend in the current UTC day, summed from D1 cost_rows through GET /api/metrics/llm-spend, never from the box's own logs/cost.csv.
Test seam: epoch seconds bin/discovery-daily.sh uses as now, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane.

Test seam: a file bin/discovery-daily.sh and bin/discovery-setup.sh source after their libs, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane: it names a file a root lane sources.

Test seam gate: bin/discovery-daily.sh honours DISCOVERY_DAILY_NOW and sources DISCOVERY_DAILY_FIXTURE only when this is 1 (the test harness sets it). Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.
